steps.content:
<size=42>At the first, the snow falls <color=#fb9259>silently</color>

Till the energy buried for years gets <color=#fb9259>awakened</color>

by a <color=#fb9259>wish</color>

or a <color=#fb9259>slogan</color>

or perhaps an <color=#fb9259>emotion</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>People</color> of all creed and color gather together

Those who were silent, lost, and scared have all found their <color=#fb9259>calling</color>

They <color=#fb9259>fraternize</color> and <color=#fb9259>join hands</color>

to form a <color=#fb9259>brotherhood</color></size>

steps.speaker: Poor Resident
steps.content: Executive Committee, get out of Syndicate!!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Executive Committee, get out of Syndicate!! Eastside lapdogs, get out of Syndicate!!

steps.speaker: Tramp
steps.content: We've had enough! Look at what you've done! Get out! Syndicate became this way all because of you!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Syndicate is ours! Rustfire will take back everything that was lost!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Our fires will rage and burn you all to ashes!
At a secret exit of Inner Bay Rail connected to a hidden sewer, three girls are hiding in the dark.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huff... huff... We've been away for only a few days... How did Syndicate end up like this?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The ringleader is obviously a gangster. Aren't gangsters and Rustfire sworn enemies? Who's he trying to fool?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I don't know... He looks really fanatical. Maybe he's infected with Mania. Stay away from him.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel him...
steps.female_content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel her...

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw... Soon, soon... ${PlayerName} went back to get help from the MBCC. They're nearby, at...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where is he right now!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Calm down! Your "shackles" are acting up and they have so much influence over you. If you go out there now and run into trouble, you'll only hold us up even longer.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Leave things here to us. Hella!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Watch over your friend, and take care of yourself. I won't be able to handle things if I'm burdened by you two dipsticks.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Dumb bird!

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw... I'm going to find help, find help. I'm going find the MBCC, the FAC, or whomever. ${PlayerName} is there. Once I find help, I'll come pick you up.
It flies away, trying to find its target. But what had been an FAC security station had been completely destroyed by the rioting mob.
The mob surges to and fro, shrieking and trying to prove themselves even when there are no targets around.

Gradually, more people join in. No one cares who the people around them really are. They all drape Rustfire-like cloaks over themselves, and splash Rustfire marks on their faces and clothes. No one cares if the marks are painted wrong.
It finally spots a comms device that's still flashing and dives towards it, only for it to get pelted and destroyed by stones the moment it lands.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Die, DisCity dogs!! Take your trash and get out of Syndicate!!!

<size=42><color=#fb9259>Anyone</color> can join

Regardless of their <color=#fb9259>past</color>

Regardless of their <color=#fb9259>motives</color></size>

<size=42><color=#fb9259>Everyone</color> gets

A brand new <color=#fb9259>name</color>

A brand new <color=#fb9259>identity</color></size>
